children: Coinbase has disabled spot trading for IoTeX (IOTX) as announced for 23 September 2026, on or around 2 PM ET. The change removes IOTX order books from one of the largest US spot venues, so holders can no longer open new trades in the token there. Funds remain accessible, and withdrawals continue at any time, so balances stay under user control rather than being frozen. Traders who keep exposure on the exchange can still move IOTX to self-custody or to another platform that lists the token. The announcement covers spot trading only, with no change stated for custody or for the asset's status beyond this venue.

Losing a major US liquidity venue narrows order depth for IOTX and can prompt immediate sell pressure as holders reposition around the cutoff. Because withdrawals stay open, that adjustment happens through transfers to other venues or self-custody instead of forced exits.
We have disabled trading for IoTeX (IOTX). Your funds will remain accessible to you, and you will continue to have the ability to withdraw your funds at any time.

title: IoTeX: Coinbase disables IOTX spot trading as withdrawals stay open - 23 Sep 2026
